# /fc:spec

[← Back to commands](../commands.md)

<!-- Generated by skills/ai-layout/scripts/sync-docs.js from commands/spec.md; do not edit. Edit docs/commands/_notes/spec.md instead. -->

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Claude name | `/fc:spec` |
| Codex name | `$fc-spec` |
| Kind | Project task — loads `ai-factory/tasks/spec.md` from your repo, so it needs an adopted workspace |
| Description | Draft a feature spec with Given/When/Then acceptance criteria |
| Arguments | `<feature request>` |

## Usage

Run `/fc:spec` when you know what to build but not yet how. The `specifier` subagent reads
`ai-factory/AGENTS.md`, `ai-factory/docs/architecture.md` and the exploration and analysis for the
feature, if either exists. It writes one spec with:

- a summary and the user story;
- Given/When/Then acceptance criteria numbered `AC1…`, each standing on its own;
- out of scope;
- an `Effort and risk` section;
- open questions;
- the data, routes and components touched.

Anything the request leaves implicit becomes an open question, never a criterion. Answer the open
questions before you run [`/fc:plan`](plan.md): a spec with open questions is not buildable.

The argument is the request, exactly as typed. Two other forms are accepted:

- **A tracker key** (`ABC-12`), when the repo has a tracker configured in
  `ai-factory/docs/tracker.md`. The key is resolved and its description becomes the request.
- **An existing spec's path**, to revise that spec in place, for example after
  [`/fc:risk`](risk.md).

See also: [Feature workflow: Spec](../workflows/feature.md#2-spec) and
[workflow.md §4](../../ai-factory/docs/workflow.md#4-the-main-loop).

## Examples

```
/fc:spec add CSV export to the reports page
/fc:spec PMB-12
/fc:spec revise ai-factory/specs/PMB-003-csv-export.md after the risk assessment
```

## Writes

- `ai-factory/specs/<ID>-*.md`. The file is created with `node ai-factory/make/ids.js new spec <slug>`.
  A re-run on an existing spec creates no new file: it edits that spec in place to add the risk
  file's open blocker and major findings, or leaves it unchanged when there is nothing to revise.
- With artifact contracts enabled, also the spec's `.contract.json` beside it.
  `contracts.js init spec` records the delivery ID (`d-YYYYMMDD-xxxxxx`), and runs again when a
  re-run edits the spec.

It writes no plan and no code.

## Refuses or asks

- With no argument, it asks which feature to specify and stops. It never invents one or takes it
  from the branch name.
- When a tracker key does not resolve, it stops and asks. It never specs the key itself.
- When one spec already records that key, it reports that spec's path and stops. When two do, it
  reports both and stops.
- When the specifier returns a question instead of a file, it asks you that question and stops.
  Headless, it reports the question, says nothing was written, and stops.
- When the repo has no `ai-factory/` workspace, it reports that it needs `/fc:adopt-sdlc`.
